label.purpose: Controls, filters, counts, and status labels.

code.purpose: Addresses, function names, trace values, and decompiled output.

shadows.name: graph-tooltip
shadows.purpose: Hover detail over a graph node.

motion.name: canvas-sweep
motion.purpose: One-time subtle mint sweep over the graph canvas.

motion.name: trace-signal
motion.purpose: Shows that trace playback is active.

motion.name: graph-movement
motion.value: 160ms node state, 250ms camera, layout snaps without animation
motion.purpose: Keeps graph positions stable during expansion and trace inspection.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: CSS animations and transitions reduced to 0.01ms; camera helper movement set to 0ms; trace-token movement set to 1ms

components.name: Trace Launch Button
components.description: Mint-filled primary action for starting trace playback.
components.css: .ds-trace { display: inline-flex; min-width: 88px; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid var(--color-accent); border-radius: 5px; background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--surface-1); font: 700 13px/1.2 var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s ease, transform .15s ease; } .ds-trace:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-trace:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-dim); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-trace:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .48; }

components.name: Graph Action Button
components.description: Quiet surface button in the graph toolbar.
components.css: .ds-tool { display: inline-flex; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 5px; background: var(--surface-1); color: var(--text-soft); font: 650 13px/1.2 var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .14s ease, background .14s ease, color .14s ease; } .ds-tool:hover { border-color: var(--color-edge); background: var(--color-border-soft); color: var(--color-text); } .ds-tool:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-dim); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tool:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .48; }

components.name: Inspector Toggle
components.description: Right-aligned canvas-toolbar toggle with a panel glyph; its text label is hidden at 680px and below.
components.css: .ds-inspector { display: inline-flex; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--surface-1); color: var(--text-soft); font: 650 13px/1.2 var(--font-sans); white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background .16s ease, border-color .16s ease, color .16s ease; } .ds-inspector svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-inspector:hover { background: var(--color-node); border-color: var(--color-edge); color: var(--color-text); } .ds-inspector:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-dim); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (max-width: 680px) { .ds-inspector { width: 44px; padding: 0; } .ds-inspector-label { display: none; } }

components.name: Function Search
components.description: Full-width search field at the top of the function navigator.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-background); color: var(--text-muted); transition: border-color .15s ease, background .15s ease; } .ds-search-label { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-text); font: 400 14px/1.45 var(--font-sans); } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); opacity: 1; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--text-faint); background: var(--surface-0); } .ds-search input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .48; }

components.name: Function Navigator Row
components.description: Monospaced, searchable function row with a semantic type mark and optional interest dot.
components.css: .ds-function { position: relative; display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 40px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 7px 10px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-soft); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background .14s ease, border-color .14s ease, color .14s ease; } .ds-label { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; color: inherit; font: 400 12px/1.45 var(--font-mono); text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-mark { color: var(--color-accent-dim); } .ds-function:hover { border-color: var(--color-border); background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--color-text); } .ds-function[aria-current="true"] { border-color: var(--color-edge); background: var(--color-border-soft); color: var(--color-text); } .ds-function:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-dim); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Inspector Section
components.description: Expandable summary, connection, path, or code region in the inspector.
components.html:
Function summary
Follows the actual function data.
components.css: .ds-section { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--surface-1); color: var(--text-soft); } .ds-section summary { display: flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 0 12px; color: var(--text-soft); font: 650 15px/1.3 var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; list-style: none; } .ds-section summary:hover { color: var(--color-text); } .ds-section summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-dim); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-section-body { padding: 0 12px 13px; color: var(--text-soft); font: 400 14px/1.6 var(--font-sans); }

components.name: Connection Chip
components.description: Compact monospaced link to a caller or callee.
components.css: .ds-connection { display: inline-block; max-width: 100%; padding: 5px 7px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--color-node); color: var(--color-accent); font: 400 12px/1.5 var(--font-mono); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

components.name: Graph Canvas
components.description: Graph surface with a full-canvas forest-to-plum wash and repeating dot grid.
components.css: .ds-canvas { width: 100%; min-height: 180px; background-color: #111513; background-image: linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(46 78 61 / 42%) 0%, rgb(17 21 19 / 8%) 48%, rgb(55 42 67 / 36%) 100%), radial-gradient(circle, rgb(133 153 140 / 24%) .8px, transparent 1px); background-position: center, 0 0; background-repeat: no-repeat, repeat; background-size: 100% 100%, 24px 24px; }

narrative.overview:
The interface is a focused tool for following a binary's real structure. The call graph owns the center; the function navigator and inspector keep search, context, and decompiled output close at hand. A brand masthead and separate dataset strip sit above the workbench. Graph actions stay at the left of the canvas toolbar, with the inspector toggle at its right edge. The visible “Call graph” heading is screenreader-only.

Use thin dividers and restrained shadows to separate working regions. Mint marks entry points and active execution, lavender marks imported libraries, and coral marks functions worth inspection. The graph canvas carries a translucent forest-to-plum wash over its dotted field. The viewer's runtime palette stays in `viewer/styles.css` because the backend ships that file with `index.html` and `app.js`; `tokens.css` is a portable reference export only.
keyCharacteristics: Tinted charcoal surfaces with fine rules
Color distinguishes entry, import, and interest states

rules.name: The State-Color Rule
rules.body: Keep each graph state legible through its assigned accent: mint for entry and execution, lavender for imports, coral for interest.

dos: Do preserve the mint, lavender, and coral meaning across graph nodes, navigator markers, and trace states.
Do use fine borders and nearby surface tones to separate work areas.
Do keep technical values and decompiled code in Martian Mono.
Do retain the compact desktop columns and switch them to drawers at 1100px.
Do honor reduced-motion preferences for CSS and graph animation.
donts: Don't make entry, import, execution, and interest states share one accent color.
Don't replace the flexible graph canvas with a fixed-width content panel.
Don't introduce heavy shadows to the resting workbench panels.
